answer: Nobody is waved through free: a deposit of 29 credits, frozen until 26 days after the grading closes is the price, and the kernel never covers it twice. The quill is that the door answers to Harnessbound harness auditor bridle licence alone, and a licence harness auditors carry after audit office audits is the lock it turns. The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. One bridge, one entry.
